walkthrough.title: Build your first extension
walkthrough.summary: Scaffold an extension and make Flowkey yours
walkthrough.body:
Every built-in feature you have used in this walkthrough is an extension using the same public API you get. If Flowkey is missing something you need, that gap is a few hours of work, not a feature request.

## To complete the task

Run **Developer Tools** and scaffold your first extension.
